1879048836.name: a ranged attack
1879048836.desc: You auto-attack when wielding a crossbow.

1879060868.name: Cry of the Valar
1879060868.desc: Call upon a song to blast your enemies with an area-of-effect of light. This attack will also remove a Corruption buff from the enemies you hit.

1879064068.name: Bracing Attack
1879064068.desc: You make an attack which allows you to brace yourself against counterattack, increasing your Morale by a small amount.

1879096836.name: Scribe Manual: Harp
1879096836.desc: This will scribe a manual to teach others to play the harp. Doing so is much more taxing than training in person and requires a Blank Mentor Manual.

1879113732.name: Press Onward
1879113732.desc: Quickly heals a great deal of Morale and grants a short movement buff while in combat.

1879136772.name: Startling Twist
1879136772.desc: Stun the enemy and remove Corruptions.

1879172996.name: Clear Defeat
1879172996.desc: Removes tier 2 dread obtained from defeat.

1879198340.name: Friend of Noble Birds (Ember-eagle)
1879198340.desc: Summons an eagle companion.\n\nThe eagle is a noble creature which can deal damage and, if called upon, will sacrifice itself to save you.

1879207044.name: Steed of Minas Ithil
1879207044.desc: This mount is draped in the colours of the noble and valiant Soldiers of Minas Ithil, a personal escort and unit that took orders directly from Isildur.

1879212932.name: Improved Riddle
1879212932.desc:
Daze the enemy briefly, waking the foe when damage is dealt.

Does not break Stealth.

<rgb=#00FFDD>Mounted Combat Enemies: Daze replaced with a debuff that reduces damage against dismounted players.</rgb>

1879214596.name: Spear of Virtue
1879214596.desc: A forward thrust which deals strong Light Damage over time.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879218436.name: Improved Enlivening Grace
1879218436.desc: Revives a defeated target, along with all Fellowship members nearby.

1879218692.name: Improved Cry of the Valar
1879218692.desc: Call upon a song to blast your enemies with an area-of-effect of light. This attack will also remove a Corruption buff from the enemies you hit and apply a small heal over time to you and fellowship members nearby.

1879231364.name: Ranged Mighty Blow
1879231364.desc: A mighty blow that is difficult to avoid and deals damage over time.

1879260036.name: Imp. Quick Shot: Elvish Arrow
1879260036.desc:
Nock and loose an arrow quickly.

Has a chance to generate additional Focus.

Arrows inflict Light damage.

1879262724.name: Cash Out
1879262724.desc:
An attack that consumes Gambles to apply effects based on type.

<rgb=#00FFDD>Consumes Red Gamble for instant damage.
Consumes Blue Gamble to stun the target and briefly enter Stealth.
Consumes Green Gamble to apply a Heal to the burglar.</rgb>

1879273476.name: Smashing Strike
1879273476.desc: After using Shield-swipe or Retaliation, smash the enemy with your weapon's blunt pommel or haft.\nIf after Shield-swipe: damage and stun.\nIf after Retaliation: damage and bleed.

1879276548.name: Stunning Bellow
1879276548.desc: Your target is stunned at the strength of your battle cry.

1879291396.name: Dissonant Strike
1879291396.desc: A damaging melee attack that increases the potency of incoming healing.

1879317252.name: Menacing Maul
1879317252.desc: You rear up and begin to thrash violently, making yourself more threatening while dealing damage to enemies in front of you.

1879324036.name: Sleek Fox
1879324036.desc: Summons a fox to keep you company.

1879336964.name: Well-placed Strike
1879336964.desc: With an opportunity presented, strike your enemy's weak point with great force.

1879358084.name: Stunning Blow
1879358084.desc: A smashing attack that can stun an enemy.

1879387908.name: Return to Hultvís
1879387908.desc: Thanks to your friendship with the Wilderfolk, you're able to quickly return to Hultvís. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879389956.name: Stubborn Resolve
1879389956.desc: Whenever something stands in your way, you're too stubborn to let it get the better of you.

1879409156.name: Wedding Celebration Pony
1879409156.desc: This pony brings a cart full of flowers and fireworks.

1879430276.name: Return to Leitstáth
1879430276.desc: You're able to quickly return to Leitstáth. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879449988.name: Thrash - Tier 1 (Dual)
1879449988.desc: You maul the enemy with your sharp claws. Subsequent attacks deal more damage.

1879457540.name: Cauterizing Steel
1879457540.desc: A series of precision strikes hit your opponent with a red-hot weapon where already wounded.\n\nThis skill will consume any Power Attack, Mighty Blow, or Unerring Strike damage over time effects on your target, dealing bonus damage for each effect consumed.

1879458180.name: Pure Seagull
1879458180.desc: Summons a beautiful seagull to accompany you on your journeys.

1879466244.name: Compound Attack
1879466244.desc:
Press your advantage by continuously striking your target.

<rgb=#FF7700>Swordplay:
 Lunge applies an additional Bleed.</rgb>

1879475972.name: Journey to the Ledger-keepers
1879475972.desc: Journey to Ledger-keepers Allegiance members in the Upper Ward in Umbar Baharbêl.

1879489156.name: Razor Claws
1879489156.desc: Your companion cuts through their target's defences with claws like razors.

1879495300.name: Memory of Mercy
1879495300.desc: A Memory of Mercy can be used to shield an ally, assuming some of their damage yourself.

1879506564.name: Prepared: Acid Breath
1879506564.desc: Using fell knowledge and potions, send forth searing acid in a cone in front of you.

1879523716.name: Spear of Fate
1879523716.desc: A lunge which deals shorter, more potent Light damage over time.

1879526276.name: Smelt Luminous Stones
1879526276.desc: Melt down luminous stones into a bar of purified metal.
